title: Horiatiki
description: The Greek village salad: ripe tomato, cucumber, onion, and pepper, a slab of feta on top, oregano, and far more olive oil than seems wise.
notes: Only worth making when tomatoes are in season. There is no lettuce in it.

steps.text: Salt the tomatoes lightly in a wide bowl.
steps.tip: The salt draws out juice, and the juice becomes the dressing with the oil.

steps.text: Add the cucumber, red onion, green bell pepper, olives, and capers and toss with the vinegar.
Lay the feta on top as one slab, sprinkle everything with the oregano, and pour over the olive oil.
steps.tip: The feta is never crumbled in the kitchen. It is broken at the table.

steps.text: Serve with bread to mop up the juices.
